collection.description: A teen's Biggles prank mask meets sightings the prank cannot explain.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A teenager makes a terrifying mask to impersonate Biggles, then discovers that several earlier sightings cannot be explained by their prank.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The village laughs, scolds, and continues arguing about the other sightings.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The teen hangs it in a hut; someone later claims to see it moving.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A festival performance makes Biggles less frightening to some children, though others remain wary.
